features.name: Customer profile edit UI with photo upload
features.description: Customer can edit name, email, and upload a profile photo. Photo is stored and served from a new bucket.

features.name: Loyalty points balance nightly sync job
features.description: A nightly job reconciles loyalty point balances between the legacy ledger and the new balance table.

criteria: User can update name/email and see validation errors inline
User can upload a JPG/PNG under 5MB as profile photo
Photo is resized and served via CDN within 2s
Discrepancies over $1 are logged for manual review
Balance table matches ledger for 99.9% of accounts after sync
